label: PF Backlog 24
title: CI/PR gating for Product Forge itself (git init + workflow)
body: Product Forge is not a git repo, so wired_audit/store/diff gates only run inside pipeline runs. Init git and install .github/workflows/structure.yml (or use the templates) so real commits are gated.
_note: DONE: added .github/workflows/structure.yml (compileall + wired_audit + backlog E2E + unit tests). Activating it needs git init in the repo root (workspace is not a git repo yet).
